title: Build immutable staged caches and a bounded challenger batch runner

proposal_scope.title: Build immutable staged caches and a bounded challenger batch runner
proposal_scope.hypothesis: A content-addressed immutable L0-L3 research cache can reuse the expensive runner-history and feature computation from a fixed pre-race snapshot while reproducing uncached candidate probabilities and pairs exactly, reducing repeated 36-race candidate-policy comparisons from minutes to seconds without weakening source-time, probability-mass, candidate-freeze, or research-only safety contracts.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: A cache key omits an input, code, feature-schema, model, policy, or source-time dependency; cached and uncached outputs differ; stale or forbidden data are accepted; a challenger can alter the frozen primary decision; or warm execution does not materially reduce repeated comparison time.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: Candidate-policy research repeatedly rebuilds identical runner history, derived runner features, Top3-set features, and coherent probabilities even when only a bounded downstream candidate or calibration policy changes. Hashing each stage by its complete upstream dependencies permits safe reuse and isolates the actual changed layer, while a single same-race batch makes primary and at most three pre-registered challengers directly comparable.
proposal_scope.target_population: Synthetic multi-card fixtures during preparation. After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, the immutable 2026-08-08 EXP023 three-card research artifacts covering 36 races and 462 runners may be used only for cold/warm parity and latency measurement; no retrospective prospective promotion or ROI analysis is allowed.
stop_conditions: A cache entry cannot be committed atomically or verified after write
A cache key cannot bind all material upstream dependencies
A preparation test would require real EXP023 data
A real-data benchmark would require current web, quote, result, payout, credential, dashboard, notification, purchase, or order access
Any production path or formal BUY field would be modified
Exact primary parity would require changing the frozen model, feature schema, calibrator, policy, threshold, or tie-break
rejection_gate: Any EXP023 row is overwritten, retrospectively promoted, or treated as new prospective evidence
Any cached and uncached canonical output differs for identical inputs
Any challenger mutates or replaces the frozen primary candidate or decision
Any dashboard, notification, credential, quote, purchase, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order side effect occurs
Any dependency, source-time, schema, model, policy, code, or safety change reuses an old cache key
Any partial, corrupt, duplicate, non-finite, probability-invalid, or forbidden-field artifact is accepted
Any real artifact is read during preparation
Any run exceeds three challengers or performs automatic winner selection
Approved warm benchmark speedup is below 3x or warm elapsed time exceeds 30 seconds without a documented bottleneck
raw_data_sources: After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant only: immutable outputs/research/EXP-20260808-023 artifacts and the exact hash-bound upstream files recorded in EXP023
No live web, market, result, payout, credential, dashboard, notification, purchase, or order source
Synthetic in-repository fixtures only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
lineage_hash_requirements: Cache hits require exact dependency equality and successful artifact and manifest hash verification
Each artifact is written atomically, read back, hashed, and referenced by an immutable canonical JSON manifest before becoming reusable
Each cache key binds the stage version, code hash, ordered dependency artifact hashes, relevant config hashes, feature schema hash, model or policy hash, source-time contract hash, and safety flags
Every output and manifest sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Every probability artifact passes finite, range, support, duplicate, Top3 mass one, and WIDE mass three contracts

L1 invalidates when L0 or feature-building dependencies change; L2 invalidates when L1, feature schema, or inference bundle changes; L3 invalidates when L2, calibrator, candidate policy, confidence policy, or tie-break changes
Primary and challenger rows share the same race and upstream cache identifiers and never use market or result information
in_scope: Add synthetic parity, invalidation, corruption, atomicity, idempotency, stage-isolation, probability-contract, and safety tests
After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, benchmark one cold build and at least two warm reads on the immutable EXP023 artifacts
Allow read-only cache hits only after complete manifest and artifact read-back verification
Ensure challenger outputs are hypothetical research columns only and cannot mutate the primary candidate, shadow action, candidate-freeze ledger, production dashboard, or order path
Implement a bounded same-race batch runner with one frozen primary and no more than three pre-registered challengers
Implement a canonical content-addressed cache key containing stage version, all upstream artifact hashes, code hash, schema hash, model or policy hash, and relevant source-time contract fields
Implement immutable L0 entry/history, L1 runner-feature, L2 coherent Top3-set and WIDE probability, and L3 candidate/calibration research artifacts
Reject overwrite, partial entries, dependency mismatch, schema mismatch, hash mismatch, duplicate race or runner identity, forbidden fields, and non-finite probability artifacts
Report wall-clock time by stage, cache-hit status, reused bytes, output parity, and speedup without calculating ROI
Store canonical manifests, dependency hashes, creation time, row and race counts, safety flags, and output hashes for every cache entry
out_of_scope: Any change to the frozen M1C model, action calibrator, confidence threshold, candidate policy, tie-break, value policy, or current Grade-R primary output
Any model training, refit, feature addition, feature selection, calibration fit, threshold search, backtest, outer OOS comparison, payout join, or ROI calculation
Any production cache replacement or modification of production runtime paths
Any public data acquisition, browser automation, credential access, quote polling, dashboard mutation, notification, purchase adapter, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any retrospective candidate freeze, promotion of late rows, or use of the cache as prospective evidence
Any unbounded model or policy search, automatic winner selection, or promotion of a challenger
Any use of odds, popularity, market rank, result, payout, ROI, or derivatives in L0-L3 candidate generation or challenger ranking
proposal_scope.data_as_of: Preparation is synthetic-only. A later approved benchmark may read only the already frozen EXP023 pre-race artifacts and their recorded source-time metadata, with no current-day result or post-race enrichment.

chronological_fold_design.design: Engineering parity and latency experiment; no learning, backtest, fold comparison, policy selection, or ROI evaluation.
chronological_fold_design.preparation_clock: Only synthetic fixtures may be read while status is APPROVED_TO_PREPARE or PREPARING.
chronological_fold_design.benchmark_clock: After APPROVED_TO_RUN, only already frozen EXP023 pre-race artifacts and source-time metadata may be read.
chronological_fold_design.cache_clock: A cache artifact is reusable only when every complete upstream dependency hash and source-time contract hash is identical.
chronological_fold_design.challenger_clock: Primary and challengers operate on one identical cached non-market snapshot; their definitions are fixed before execution.
chronological_fold_design.prospective_rule: Benchmark outputs are engineering evidence only and cannot repair, replace, or promote any EXP023 prospective row.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real artifact read or timing benchmark is allowed before a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant.

purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may enter any cached candidate or challenger stage.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No result or post-race artifact may be cached in L0-L3.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: Benchmark population is the complete fixed EXP023 population and cannot be filtered by runtime, success, candidate, or outcome.
purge_embargo.cache_invalidation: Any dependency difference produces a new key; fallback to a stale or nearest cache entry is forbidden.
purge_embargo.challenger_limit: At most three pre-registered challengers plus one frozen primary; no dynamic variant generation or automatic best-policy selection.

primary_metric.name: warm_candidate_comparison_latency_with_exact_parity
primary_metric.baseline: EXP023 required 375.9 seconds end to end and reported reused=false for the heavy upstream prediction path.
primary_metric.evaluation: Warm elapsed time for a same-input primary plus bounded challenger comparison, conditional on byte-equivalent canonical outputs and all safety and probability contracts passing.

notes: Performance-only research infrastructure: immutable staged cache and bounded challenger batch; no model/policy/ROI/BUY change.
